entries.description: Central white-label config: app_name 'Avuz Conecta', account_type 'avuzconecta', authority 'com.avuz.conecta', data_folder, db_file/name, user-agent strings. Avuz palette (primary #2bb5e3, primary_dark #1e9bc7, accent #d2e314, bg_splash #f2f6fb). Drawer header dimensions. Privacy URL → avuz.cloud. Splash text 'Avuz Conecta'. is_branded_client=true.
entries.notes: Upstream-supported override file. Most changes here are conflict-free. Watch for new keys added upstream.

entries.description: Disabled flags: help_enabled=false, sourcecode_enabled=false, participate_enabled=false (hides Community menu), imprint_enabled=false, logger_enabled=false, show_drawer_logout=false, recently_modified_enabled=false, show_provider_or_own_installation=false (hides 'Sign up with provider' + 'Host your own server' on first-run intro).
entries.notes: show_provider_or_own_installation also affects DrawerActivity add-account flow and UserListAdapter — intended single-flag toggle.

entries.description: Bumped androidLibraryVersion 827db94 → 264573e (master HEAD 2026-04-28). Original sha had broken JitPack POM artifact (404 only on .pom, .aar served).
entries.notes: Forward-bumped from upstream-pinned sha. Revert when upstream pins a new working sha. Watch for nextcloud-android-library API drift on next merge.
Conflict-prone on version bumps. Reapply applicationId after each upstream version merge.

entries.description: Branded notification icon — 3 Avuz dots vector (monochrome white). Used by foreground service notifications (file upload/download progress, sync, scan-to-pdf). Replaces Nextcloud 3-circles trademark mark.
entries.notes: Android notification small icons must be white-only on transparent bg (system applies tint).

entries.description: Avuz launcher icons (3 dots: blue/olive/gray) replacing Nextcloud trademark mark. Adaptive icon (foreground + background + monochrome for Android 13+). Legacy raster fallbacks per density.
entries.notes: Source PNGs in /assets/ (icon.png). Regenerate via Image Asset Studio if dimensions change.

entries.description: Splash screen with Avuz logo. branded_splash_logo.xml is alias → avuz_splash_logo PNG. Layout uses setup.xml dimensions and bg_splash color.
entries.notes: activity_splash.xml is upstream layout — watch for structural changes. Alias pattern isolates asset swap.

entries.description: Drawer header logo + sizing. Alias pattern (branded_drawer_logo) → avuz_drawer_logo PNG. Layout pulls dimensions/colors from setup.xml.
entries.notes: drawer_header.xml conflicts possible if upstream restructures header. Bindings use setup.xml refs to minimize surface.

entries.description: Replace Nextcloud trademark logo with Avuz wordmark on login + first-run + deep-link + media preview placeholder. branded_login_logo.xml = bitmap wrapper applying android:tint=@android:color/white over avuz_logo.png. Layouts swap @drawable/logo → @drawable/branded_login_logo. Also hides scan_qr ImageButton on login (visibility=gone in account_setup.xml).
entries.notes: Tint paints opaque pixels white, transparent stays transparent — works on solid Avuz blue bg. Source PNG in /assets/logo2.png.

entries.description: Reduced first-run intro from 4 pages (logo, files, groupware, talk) to single page (Avuz logo only). Hides ProgressIndicator when itemCount==1.
entries.notes: If upstream adds a new feature page, our companion-object array must be re-trimmed. Conflict-prone on FirstRunActivity edits.

entries.description: splash_image_size 180dp → 220dp. Bigger logo on first-run intro + login thumbnail.
entries.notes: Single dimen, shared by whats_new_element.xml and account_setup.xml. Conflict-prone on upstream dims.xml edits.

entries.description: login_text_hint_color #7fd2e8f0 → #b3ffffff (70% white). Cleaner on Avuz blue login bg.
entries.notes: Color override only; no code path.

entries.description: Style tweaks for Avuz palette consistency. Theme.ownCloud.Launcher: parent → Theme.Material3.Light.NoActionBar (kills inflated AppCompat ActionBar that painted colorPrimary blue band at top). windowActionBar=false, windowNoTitle=true. windowBackground/statusBarColor/navigationBarColor → bg_drawer_header (#f2f6fb white). windowLightStatusBar/Navigation=true. Theme.App.Starting (system splash): mirrored white system bars + windowSplashScreenIconBackgroundColor=white + colorPrimary/Dark overrides for cold-start frame. Result: all-white launch + splash, no blue strips.
entries.notes: styles.xml is large and upstream-active. Audit each merge for missed updates.

entries.description: Release build minification DISABLED (isMinifyEnabled=false) to match upstream Nextcloud config. Upstream ships release unminified — code is not tested with R8 and minification breaks reflection-based features (Apache HttpClient via OwnCloudClientFactory, Guava TypeToken in FileUploadWorker, etc). proguard-rules.pro retained for future re-enable if needed but currently unused.
entries.notes: Trade-off: ~3x larger AAB (~140MB vs ~45MB) but zero R8-related crashes. Play AAB delivery + per-ABI/density splits keep on-device install size reasonable. Revisit only if shipping minify becomes essential.
